homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：阿尔巴尼亚公民去中国可以不用签证吗？

mutual.extraIntroZh: 阿尔巴尼亚公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。

mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与阿尔巴尼亚实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，阿尔巴尼亚公民可入境中国90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与阿尔巴尼亚双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留90天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Albania implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Albania citizens may enter China for up to 90 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 90 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

homeImportantNotesZh: 该国公民目前可关注的中国入境方式包括：单方面免签（30天）、240小时过境免签（10天）。
不同免签方式的允许活动并不完全相同，出行前应查看对应政策详情。该国数据列明的常见入境目的包括：经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境；过境、旅游、经商、探亲访友。
如使用过境免签，出行前应确认符合条件的联程行程、适用口岸及允许活动区域。
homeImportantNotesEn: Available China entry options for this nationality include: unilateral visa-free (30 days), 240-hour transit visa-free (10 days).

Permitted activities depend on the specific policy; check the policy detail before relying on a visa-free entry option. Common purposes listed for this nationality are: Business, tourism, family visit, exchange, transit; Transit, tourism, business, family visit.
For transit visa-free travel, confirm the qualifying onward itinerary, eligible port and permitted travel area before departure.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：奥地利公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受240小时过境免签10天、单方面免签30天。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民来中国需要签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 是否需要签证取决于适用的中国免签政策、护照类型和入境目的，请在出行前查看下方对应政策详情。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民可以使用哪一种中国免签政策？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 该国对应多个中国入境方式，应结合停留期限、入境目的和其他条件选择适用政策。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民免签来华可以工作或学习吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 免签入境并不当然赋予工作或正式学习资格，开展相关活动前应确认适用的签证或许可要求。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民来华前应该检查哪些事项？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 出行前应确认政策有效期、适用护照、入境目的、停留期限，以及所选入境方式对应的行程或口岸条件。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Austria citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy 240-hour transit visa-free for 10 days, unilateral visa-free for 30 days.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Austria citizens need a visa to travel to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: The answer depends on which China visa-free scheme applies to your nationality, passport and travel purpose. Check the available policy details below before departure.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Which China visa-free option can Austria citizens use?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: This country has more than one listed China entry option. Compare the stay period, travel purpose and entry conditions on the policy cards below.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Can Austria citizens work or study in China without a visa?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate visa or authorization before undertaking these activities.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Austria citizens need accommodation registration in China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration in accordance with applicable regulations.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: What should Austria citizens check before traveling to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Check the policy validity, eligible passport, permitted travel purpose, stay limit and any itinerary or port conditions that apply to your chosen entry option.

transit.customAlertZh: ⚠️过境免签提示：选择240小时过境免签，必须真正前往第三国，不能以单纯旅游作为入境目的。
transit.customAlertEn: ⚠️Transit visa-free reminder: Under 240-hour transit visa-free scheme, you must actually travel onward to a third country; pure tourism is not accepted as entry purpose.
transit.extraIntroZh: 奥地利公民同时可适用240小时过境免签政策，最长停留10天。
transit.extraIntroEn: Austria citizens are also covered by the 240-hour transit visa-free scheme for maximum 10-day stay.
transit.policyExplainZh: 240小时过境免签专为中转旅客设计，核心前提是必须持有已经确认的前往第三国/地区的联程机票，不适合纯粹来华旅游。允许在24个指定省份的开放口岸入境，并且在许可区域内跨省出行。
transit.policyExplainEn: The 240-hour transit visa-free scheme is designed for connecting transit passengers. Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross-province within permitted zones.

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民可以使用中国240小时过境免签吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要同时满足国籍、联程行程、适用口岸及其他过境免签条件。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民过境免签可以在中国停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的过境免签最长停留10天，具体以适用条件为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民过境免签需要联程机票吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要满足前往第三国或地区的联程行程条件，具体以适用政策和承运人要求为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Can Austria citizens use China's 240-hour transit visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: Eligibility depends on nationality, qualifying transit itinerary, designated ports and other applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Austria citizens stay in China under transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed transit visa-free stay is up to 10 days, subject to the applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Austria citizens need an onward ticket for transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: A qualifying onward itinerary to a third country or region is a core condition of the applicable transit visa-free policy.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Austria citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：奥地利单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Austria unilateral visa-free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 奥地利公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Austria citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa-free entry for business, tourism, family visit, exchange and transit.
unilateral.policyExplainZh: 中国对奥地利实施单方面免签政策，该政策由中国单方面给予奥地利公民入境便利，并非双边互免协定。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算，目前无入境次数限制。政策存在有效期，到期后规则存在调整可能性。
unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa-free treatment for Austria citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry-count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：奥地利公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民免签来华可以停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的单方面免签最长停留30天，具体以适用条件及政策有效期为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民免签来华可以从事哪些活动？
customFaqsZh.a: 允许的入境目的以对应免签政策列明的目的为准，出行前请查看政策详情。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民免签期间可以在中国工作或学习吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 免签入境并不当然赋予工作或正式学习资格，开展相关活动前应确认适用要求。

customFaqsZh.q: 奥地利公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Austria citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry-count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Austria citizens stay in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed unilateral visa-free policy allows a stay of up to 30 days, subject to the applicable conditions and policy validity.

customFaqsEn.q: What can Austria citizens do in China during a visa-free stay?
customFaqsEn.a: Permitted purposes are those listed in the applicable policy. Check the purpose field and policy notes before departure.

customFaqsEn.q: Can Austria citizens work or study in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate requirements before undertaking these activities.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Austria citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa-free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：巴哈马公民去中国可以不用签证吗？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民免签来华可以停留多久？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民来华前应该检查哪些事项？

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Bahamas citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy mutual visa exemption for stay up to 90 days.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Bahamas citizens need a visa to travel to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: The answer depends on which China visa-free scheme applies to your nationality, passport and travel purpose. Check the available policy details below before departure.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: How long can Bahamas citizens stay in China without a visa?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Under the listed mutual visa exemption, the maximum stay is 90 days, subject to the applicable policy conditions.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Can Bahamas citizens work or study in China without a visa?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate visa or authorization before undertaking these activities.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Bahamas citizens need accommodation registration in China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration in accordance with applicable regulations.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: What should Bahamas citizens check before traveling to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Check the policy validity, eligible passport, permitted travel purpose, stay limit and any itinerary or port conditions that apply to your chosen entry option.

mutual.extraIntroZh: 巴哈马公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
mutual.extraIntroEn: Bahamas citizens are eligible for China's mutual visa exemption for stay up to 90 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit.
mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与巴哈马实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，巴哈马公民可入境中国90天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与巴哈马双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留90天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Bahamas implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Bahamas citizens may enter China for up to 90 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 90 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：巴哈马公民互免签证入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，根据双边互免协定，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过90天。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民在中国互免签证可以停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的互免签证单次最长停留90天，具体以适用双边协定为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民哪些护照可以享受互免签证？
customFaqsZh.a: 具体适用护照种类以相关双边互免签证协定为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民可以多次免签进入中国吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 是否可以多次入境以及相关条件，以适用双边协定和证件情况为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴哈马公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Bahamas citizens enter China multiple times under mutual visa exemption?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. Under the bilateral reciprocal agreement, there is currently no entry-count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 90 days.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Bahamas citizens stay in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed mutual visa exemption allows a stay of up to 90 days per the applicable bilateral agreement.

customFaqsEn.q: What passport is eligible for Bahamas citizens under China's mutual visa exemption?
customFaqsEn.a: Eligible passport types are determined by the applicable bilateral visa exemption agreement.

customFaqsEn.q: Can Bahamas citizens enter China more than once under mutual visa exemption?
customFaqsEn.a: Entry frequency depends on the applicable bilateral agreement and the conditions attached to the travel document.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Bahamas citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

mutual.exclusionNoteZh: 互免签证仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
mutual.exclusionNoteEn: Mutual visa exemption applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

homeImportantNotesZh: 该国公民目前可关注的中国入境方式包括：单方面免签（30天）、240小时过境免签（10天）。

如使用过境免签，出行前应确认符合条件的联程行程、适用口岸及允许活动区域。
homeImportantNotesEn: Available China entry options for this nationality include: unilateral visa-free (30 days), 240-hour transit visa-free (10 days).

Permitted activities depend on the specific policy; check the policy detail before relying on a visa-free entry option. Common purposes listed for this nationality are: Business, tourism, family visit, exchange, transit; Transit, tourism, business, family visit.
For transit visa-free travel, confirm the qualifying onward itinerary, eligible port and permitted travel area before departure.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：巴西公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受240小时过境免签10天、单方面免签30天。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民来中国需要签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 是否需要签证取决于适用的中国免签政策、护照类型和入境目的，请在出行前查看下方对应政策详情。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民可以使用哪一种中国免签政策？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 该国对应多个中国入境方式，应结合停留期限、入境目的和其他条件选择适用政策。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民免签来华可以工作或学习吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 免签入境并不当然赋予工作或正式学习资格，开展相关活动前应确认适用的签证或许可要求。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民来华前应该检查哪些事项？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: 出行前应确认政策有效期、适用护照、入境目的、停留期限，以及所选入境方式对应的行程或口岸条件。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Brazil citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy 240-hour transit visa-free for 10 days, unilateral visa-free for 30 days.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Brazil citizens need a visa to travel to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: The answer depends on which China visa-free scheme applies to your nationality, passport and travel purpose. Check the available policy details below before departure.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Which China visa-free option can Brazil citizens use?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: This country has more than one listed China entry option. Compare the stay period, travel purpose and entry conditions on the policy cards below.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Can Brazil citizens work or study in China without a visa?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate visa or authorization before undertaking these activities.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Brazil citizens need accommodation registration in China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration in accordance with applicable regulations.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: What should Brazil citizens check before traveling to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Check the policy validity, eligible passport, permitted travel purpose, stay limit and any itinerary or port conditions that apply to your chosen entry option.

transit.customAlertZh: ⚠️过境免签提示：选择240小时过境免签，必须真正前往第三国，不能以单纯旅游作为入境目的。

Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross-province within permitted zones.

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民可以使用中国240小时过境免签吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要同时满足国籍、联程行程、适用口岸及其他过境免签条件。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民过境免签可以在中国停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的过境免签最长停留10天，具体以适用条件为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民过境免签需要联程机票吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要满足前往第三国或地区的联程行程条件，具体以适用政策和承运人要求为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Can Brazil citizens use China's 240-hour transit visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: Eligibility depends on nationality, qualifying transit itinerary, designated ports and other applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Brazil citizens stay in China under transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed transit visa-free stay is up to 10 days, subject to the applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Brazil citizens need an onward ticket for transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: A qualifying onward itinerary to a third country or region is a core condition of the applicable transit visa-free policy.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Brazil citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：巴西单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Brazil unilateral visa-free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 巴西公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。

unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa-free treatment for Brazil citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry-count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：巴西公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民免签来华可以停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的单方面免签最长停留30天，具体以适用条件及政策有效期为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民免签来华可以从事哪些活动？
customFaqsZh.a: 允许的入境目的以对应免签政策列明的目的为准，出行前请查看政策详情。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民免签期间可以在中国工作或学习吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 免签入境并不当然赋予工作或正式学习资格，开展相关活动前应确认适用要求。

customFaqsZh.q: 巴西公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Brazil citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry-count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Brazil citizens stay in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed unilateral visa-free policy allows a stay of up to 30 days, subject to the applicable conditions and policy validity.

customFaqsEn.q: What can Brazil citizens do in China during a visa-free stay?
customFaqsEn.a: Permitted purposes are those listed in the applicable policy. Check the purpose field and policy notes before departure.

customFaqsEn.q: Can Brazil citizens work or study in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate requirements before undertaking these activities.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Brazil citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa-free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页

✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查

⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.

Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。

checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页

✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。

pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Maldives citizens need a visa for China?

mutual.extraIntroZh: 马尔代夫公民可以享受互免签证入境中国，停留30天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
mutual.extraIntroEn: Maldives citizens are eligible for China's mutual visa exemption for stay up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit.
mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与马尔代夫实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，马尔代夫公民可入境中国30天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与马尔代夫双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。
mutual.policyExplainEn: China and Maldives implement mutual visa exemption under bilateral agreement. Maldives citizens may enter China for up to 30 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection

免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。

mutual.policyExplainZh: 中国与毛里求斯实施互免签证政策，根据双边协定，毛里求斯公民可入境中国60天，适用于旅游、商务、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。该政策由中国与毛里求斯双方共同签署，互为对方公民提供入境便利。每次入境最长停留60天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算。

Mauritius citizens may enter China for up to 60 days for tourism, business, family visit, exchange and transit. This policy is jointly agreed upon by both countries. Maximum stay is 60 days per entry, counted from 00:00 the day after arrival.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。

checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages

homeImportantNotesEn: Available China entry options for this nationality include: unilateral visa-free (30 days), 240-hour transit visa-free (10 days).

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：波兰公民去中国可以不用签证吗？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民来中国需要签证吗？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民可以使用哪一种中国免签政策？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民免签来华可以工作或学习吗？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民来华前应该检查哪些事项？

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Which China visa-free option can Poland citizens use?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: This country has more than one listed China entry option. Compare the stay period, travel purpose and entry conditions on the policy cards below.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Can Poland citizens work or study in China without a visa?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate visa or authorization before undertaking these activities.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Poland citizens need accommodation registration in China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration in accordance with applicable regulations.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: What should Poland citizens check before traveling to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Check the policy validity, eligible passport, permitted travel purpose, stay limit and any itinerary or port conditions that apply to your chosen entry option.

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民过境免签可以在中国停留多久？

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民过境免签需要联程机票吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要满足前往第三国或地区的联程行程条件，具体以适用政策和承运人要求为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？

customFaqsEn.q: Can Poland citizens use China's 240-hour transit visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: Eligibility depends on nationality, qualifying transit itinerary, designated ports and other applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Poland citizens stay in China under transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed transit visa-free stay is up to 10 days, subject to the applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Poland citizens need an onward ticket for transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: A qualifying onward itinerary to a third country or region is a core condition of the applicable transit visa-free policy.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Poland citizens need accommodation registration in China?

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：波兰单方面免签政策自2025-12-01起实施，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Poland unilateral visa-free policy has been in effect since 2025-12-01. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 波兰公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，适用于经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Poland citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30-day visa-free entry for business, tourism, family visit, exchange and transit.

unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa-free treatment for Poland citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry-count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round-trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round-trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa-free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision-making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part-time jobs or internships under visa-free status, this will cause illegal-stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in-person.
Visa-free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：波兰公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民免签来华可以停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的单方面免签最长停留30天，具体以适用条件及政策有效期为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民免签来华可以从事哪些活动？
customFaqsZh.a: 允许的入境目的以对应免签政策列明的目的为准，出行前请查看政策详情。

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民免签期间可以在中国工作或学习吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 免签入境并不当然赋予工作或正式学习资格，开展相关活动前应确认适用要求。

customFaqsZh.q: 波兰公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Poland citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry-count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Poland citizens stay in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed unilateral visa-free policy allows a stay of up to 30 days, subject to the applicable conditions and policy validity.

customFaqsEn.q: What can Poland citizens do in China during a visa-free stay?
customFaqsEn.a: Permitted purposes are those listed in the applicable policy. Check the purpose field and policy notes before departure.

customFaqsEn.q: Can Poland citizens work or study in China visa-free?
customFaqsEn.a: Visa-free entry does not automatically authorize employment or formal study. Confirm the appropriate requirements before undertaking these activities.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Poland citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.

checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页

pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。

customFaqsZh.q: 英国公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Do Vietnam citizens need accommodation registration in China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration in accordance with applicable regulations.

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: What should Vietnam citizens check before traveling to China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: Check the policy validity, eligible passport, permitted travel purpose, stay limit and any itinerary or port conditions that apply to your chosen entry option.

transit.customAlertZh: ⚠️过境免签提示：选择240小时过境免签，必须真正前往第三国，不能以单纯旅游作为入境目的。
transit.customAlertEn: ⚠️Transit visa-free reminder: Under 240-hour transit visa-free scheme, you must actually travel onward to a third country; pure tourism is not accepted as entry purpose.
transit.extraIntroZh: 越南公民同时可适用240小时过境免签政策，最长停留10天。
transit.extraIntroEn: Vietnam citizens are also covered by the 240-hour transit visa-free scheme for maximum 10-day stay.
transit.policyExplainZh: 240小时过境免签专为中转旅客设计，核心前提是必须持有已经确认的前往第三国/地区的联程机票，不适合纯粹来华旅游。允许在24个指定省份的开放口岸入境，并且在许可区域内跨省出行。
transit.policyExplainEn: The 240-hour transit visa-free scheme is designed for connecting transit passengers. Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross-province within permitted zones.

customFaqsZh.q: 越南公民可以使用中国240小时过境免签吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要同时满足国籍、联程行程、适用口岸及其他过境免签条件。

customFaqsZh.q: 越南公民过境免签可以在中国停留多久？
customFaqsZh.a: 目前列出的过境免签最长停留10天，具体以适用条件为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 越南公民过境免签需要联程机票吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 需要满足前往第三国或地区的联程行程条件，具体以适用政策和承运人要求为准。

customFaqsZh.q: 越南公民在中国需要办理住宿登记吗？
customFaqsZh.a: 外国人在中国境内住宿，一般需要按照相关规定办理住宿登记。

customFaqsEn.q: Can Vietnam citizens use China's 240-hour transit visa-free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: Eligibility depends on nationality, qualifying transit itinerary, designated ports and other applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: How long can Vietnam citizens stay in China under transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: The listed transit visa-free stay is up to 10 days, subject to the applicable conditions.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Vietnam citizens need an onward ticket for transit visa-free entry?
customFaqsEn.a: A qualifying onward itinerary to a third country or region is a core condition of the applicable transit visa-free policy.

customFaqsEn.q: Do Vietnam citizens need accommodation registration in China?
customFaqsEn.a: Foreign visitors staying in China generally need accommodation registration according to applicable regulations.
